patterns.pattern: Service contracts with site-specific work keywords (exploration, survey, installation, field testing, bridge, dam, park) are misclassified as construction due to overlapping location and activity terminology.
patterns.suggested_data_fix: Add training examples of professional services containing construction-adjacent keywords (survey, exploration, installation, geotechnical, field testing) explicitly labeled as Professional Services.

patterns.pattern: Facilities records using service-oriented language (management support, planning, technical data, restoration services, environmental support) are misclassified as professional services due to the prevalence of 'services' and 'support' terms.
patterns.suggested_data_fix: Augment training data with facilities/construction records containing service-framework phrasing (construction management support, planning updates, forestry restoration, imagery analysis) labeled as Facilities & Construction.

patterns.pattern: Sustainment spare parts and components (pumps, bearings, wheels, clamps) with NSNs, part numbers, and hardware-specific nomenclature resemble industrial product purchases.
patterns.suggested_data_fix: Inject more sustainment examples featuring NSN/part-number patterns and component-level terminology (assembly, repair, spare, replacement, metering) labeled as Sustainment S&E.

patterns.pattern: Industrial product procurements (gear assemblies, fuel systems, filters, manifolds, coolant drums) with assembly/part descriptors, NSNs, and quantities mimic sustainment spare-part orders.
patterns.suggested_data_fix: Add industrial product examples with part-like specifications (assembly, system, distribution, drum, filter) and NSNs labeled as Industrial Products & Services to differentiate procurement from sustainment.
